candidate.name: FORBIDDEN_PATTERN_MINIMAL_BASIS_QUOTIENT_COMPILER
candidate.state: canonical forbidden partial assignment / equivalently a canonical clause
candidate.quotient_1: different derivation histories yielding identical clause content are one state
candidate.quotient_2: a clause/pattern semantically dominated by an already known stronger subsuming clause is not a new decision-relevant state
candidate.resolution_rule: resolve two active canonical clauses only when they carry complementary pivot literals; retain only non-tautological resolvents of width <=4
candidate.dominance_rule: if C subseteq D as literal sets, conjunction containing C already implies D; D is redundant and may be removed from the active semantic basis while its proof provenance is retained
candidate.candidate_output: active bridge-only minimal clause basis after fixed point

polynomial_state_bound.reason: every canonical non-tautological clause of width <=4 corresponds to one partial assignment on at most four variables
polynomial_state_bound.claim_scope: state-universe cardinality only; practical runtime and completeness of the chosen transition grammar are empirical gates, and no arbitrary-CNF polynomial SAT result is preregistered

forbidden_candidate_operations: truth-table witness access before candidate fixed point
lossy pruning without an exact semantic dominance proof

controls.positive: tiny formulas whose naive width-4 closure and quotient minimal-basis closure have the same semantic basis
controls.negative: sign-changed clauses and non-subsuming clauses must not collapse
controls.proof_replay: every retained derived clause must have a replayable resolution provenance
controls.independent_witness: R10/R11 exact finite bridge witness runs only after candidate fixed point

verdict_rule.MATCH: candidate bridge basis accepts exactly the immutable 135/127 assignments with zero false negatives and proof replay passes
verdict_rule.MISMATCH: candidate reaches fixed point but its bridge relation differs from the immutable exact witness
verdict_rule.OPEN_RESOURCE: candidate fails to reach fixed point under the frozen execution resource envelope; this is not negative evidence about semantic impossibility

claim_ceiling: At most a scoped compiler result for the two frozen bridge interfaces. No general SAT algorithm, global quotient bound over arbitrary search grammars, P=NP result, or proof-complexity theorem follows.
